time_control.reason: The protocol observes time exclusively through dispersed wall-clock calls: randomTimeout returns time.After(minVal+extra) (util.go:39), follower/candidate/leader loops use time.After/time.Now (raft.go:163, 217, 310, 677, 728, 749), replication uses time.After backoff and time.Now (replication.go:131, 213, 230, 343, 411), snapshot and log-store metric loops use time.After (snapshot.go:75, log.go:180), and saturation/metrics use time.Now (saturation.go:47). There is no explicit Tick method and no injectable Clock type anywhere in the package (no Clock symbol exists). Per the v0.1 rule, dispersed wall-clock use without explicit Tick or injectable Clock is INVASIVE: deterministic advancement cannot be provided without restructuring time usage throughout the main loops.
